from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u034/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque
def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the nearest compact object to the long straight/extended marker shape.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(x for r in grid for x in r), key=lambda c:sum(v==c for r in grid for v in r))
    # identify dominant color other than background that forms an extended bar (many cells, long bounding dimension)
    comps=[]; seen=set()
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
       c=grid[i][j]
       if c==bg or (i,j) in seen: continue
       q=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); a=[]
       while q:
        x,y=q.pop(); a.append((x,y))
        for u,v in ((x+1,y),(x-1,y),(x,y+1),(x,y-1)):
         if 0<=u<h and 0<=v<w and grid[u][v]==c and (u,v) not in seen: seen.add((u,v));q.append((u,v))
       comps.append((c,a))
    # elongated component identifies marker, then recolor nearest other component to marker color
    marker=max(comps,key=lambda z: max(max(x for x,y in z[1])-min(x for x,y in z[1])+1,max(y for x,y in z[1])-min(y for x,y in z[1])+1))
    mc,ma=marker
    targets=[(c,a) for c,a in comps if (c,a)!=marker]
    c,a=min(targets,key=lambda z:min(abs(x-u)+abs(y-v) for x,y in z[1] for u,v in ma))
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for x,y in a: out[x][y]=mc
    return out
'''
